name: Pokémon Edición Sombría: Vientos del Pasado
storyline:
After becoming Pokémon League Champions and travelling around Kanto, our heroes return to Johto for a well-deserved rest. However, the peace is short-lived… A mysterious discovery upsets the balance of the Pokémon world:
Teleporters capable of sending humans back to a very early era in the region’s history.
What at first appears to be an unprecedented technological breakthrough is merely the beginning of a greater conflict.
Who created this technology?
Who is behind its exploitation?
Who can manipulate this temporal advantage?
What Pokémon exist in that primitive era?
The answers will lead the player to explore not only a Johto altered by these new events, but also its temporal counterparts and other regions yet to be confirmed.
The journey will be darker, more dangerous and more complex than ever before.
summary: It is a fan game conceived as a successor to Pokémon Shadow Edition and a reimagined spiritual sequel to the events following Pokémon HeartGold and Pokémon SoulSilver. The project combines the classic essence of the series with modern mechanics and elements inspired by other RPGs, without compromising the original identity of Pokémon. Furthermore, it places a strong emphasis on expanding the lore and on a deeper, more cohesive narrative within the Pokémon world.
